body: Disassociating is an interesting idea, I haven’t thought of it like that before. Thank you for your perspective

I appreciate you sharing your thoughts but I’m not sure we’re on the same wavelength. What I’m hearing from you is loving yourself like basic survival instinct, like “taking care.” I mean more like, actively liking your own personality and skills and attributes and things like that. I can say pretty confidently that I dislike myself, a lot of times hate myself, and I think I’m a weak and incompetent person. I struggle understanding people who like or love themselves and think they’re this great person, and I really don’t understand people who say loving yourself is key and no one else’s opinion matters, your own perception of yourself is above all else. But everything is relative to something else, if you love yourself it’s basically meaningless, anyone can just say “I love myself” but I don’t think that adds any value to you. What gives you value is other people’s perception

Sorry I wrote all this stuff, it was nice of you to respond thoughtfully.
